affinity.description:
Assign a group of affinity scheduling rules
The default nodeAffinity excludes Fargate nodes and virtual kubelets from scheduling
unless overridden by hard node affinity set in the field.
nodeAffinity:
requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
nodeSelectorTerms:
- matchFields:
- key: metadata.name
operator: In
values:
- target-host-name

commonLabels.description: Extra labels to attach to all resources (can be templated)

configmaps.description:
Additional configmaps to be mounted.
- name: <configMapName>
mountPath: <mountPath>

daemonsetAnnotations.description: Annotations to be added to node exporter daemonset

dnsConfig.description:
Custom DNS configuration to be added to prometheus-node-exporter pods
nameservers:
- 1.2.3.4
searches:
- ns1.svc.cluster-domain.example
- my.dns.search.suffix
options:
- name: ndots
value: "2"
- name: edns0

dnsPolicy.description:
DNS policy for prometheus-node-exporter pods
When hostNetwork is true, you typically want "Default" or "ClusterFirstWithHostNet"
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-s-dns-policy

endpoints.description:
for deployments that have node_exporter deployed outside of the cluster, list
their addresses here

env.description:
Additional environment variables that will be passed to the daemonset
env:
VARIABLE: value

extraHostVolumeMounts.description:
Additional mounts from the host to node-exporter container
- name: <mountName>
hostPath: <hostPath>
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes/#hostpath-volume-types
type: "" (Default)|DirectoryOrCreate|Directory|FileOrCreate|File|Socket|CharDevice|BlockDevice
mountPath: <mountPath>
readOnly: true|false
mountPropagation: None|HostToContainer|Bidirectional

extraInitContainers.description: Additional InitContainers to initialize the pod

extraManifests.description:
Extra manifests to deploy as an array
- |
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
name: prometheus-extra
data:
extra-data: "value"

extraVolumeMounts.description:
Extra volume mounts in the node-exporter container
- name: extra-volume
mountPath: /extra
readOnly: true

extraVolumes.description:
Extra volumes to become available in the pod
- name: extra-volume
secret:
defaultMode: 420
optional: false
secretName: node-exporter-secret

hostNetwork.description: Expose the service to the host network

hostPID.description: Share the host process ID namespace

hostProcFsMount.description: Mount the node's proc file system (/proc) at /host/proc in the container

hostRootFsMount.description: Mount the node's root file system (/) at /host/root in the container

hostSysFsMount.description: Mount the node's sys file system (/sys) at /host/sys in the container

hostUsers.description:
hostUsers should be `true` or `~` if hostNetwork is true
for more information on the limitations of hostUsers
see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/user-namespaces/#limitations

image.description:
Default values for prometheus-node-exporter.
This is a YAML-formatted file.
Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

kubeRBACProxy.description:
Configure kube-rbac-proxy. When enabled, creates a kube-rbac-proxy to protect the node-exporter http endpoint.
The requests are served through the same service but requests are HTTPS.

networkPolicy.description:
Set a NetworkPolicy with:
ingress only on service.port or custom policy
no egress permitted

nodeSelector.description: Assign a nodeSelector if operating a hybrid cluster

permissionInitContainer.description: Additional InitContainer to fix hostfile permissions required for some exporters. All fixes are disabled by default.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to be added to node exporter pods

podLabels.description: Extra labels to add to node exporter pods (can be templated)

releaseLabel.description: set to true to add the release label so scraping of the servicemonitor with kube-prometheus-stack works out of the box

resources.description:
We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
limits:
cpu: 200m
memory: 50Mi
requests:
cpu: 100m
memory: 30Mi

restartPolicy.description:
Specify the container restart policy passed to the Node Export container
Possible Values: Always (default)|OnFailure|Never

revisionHistoryLimit.description:
Number of old history to retain to allow rollback
Default Kubernetes value is set to 10

sidecarHostVolumeMounts.description:
Additional mounts from the host to sidecar containers
- name: <mountName>
hostPath: <hostPath>
mountPath: <mountPath>
readOnly: true|false
mountPropagation: None|HostToContainer|Bidirectional

sidecarVolumeMount.description:
Volume for sidecar containers
- name: collector-textfiles
mountPath: /run/prometheus
readOnly: false

sidecars.description:
Additional containers for export metrics to text file; fields image,imagePullPolicy,securityContext take default value from main container
- name: nvidia-dcgm-exporter
image: nvidia/dcgm-exporter:1.4.3
volumeMounts:
- name: tmp
mountPath: /tmp

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Specify grace period for graceful termination of pods. Defaults to 30 if null or not specified

terminationMessageParams.description:
Enable or disable container termination message settings
https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/debug/debug-application/determine-reason-pod-failure/

tlsSecret.description:
tlsSecret refers to an existing secret holding TLS items: client CA certificate, private key and certificate.
secretName and volumeName can be templated.
If enabled, volume volumeName gets created on secret secretName.
The volume's resources will be used by kube-rbac-proxy if kubeRBACProxy.tls.enabled is set.

version.description: Override version of app, required if image.tag is defined and does not follow semver

verticalPodAutoscaler.description: Enable vertical pod autoscaler support for prometheus-node-exporter
